end.summary:
Pari showed understanding of common non-metals and their solid, liquid or gas states, including chlorine, sulphur and iodine.
Pari practised everyday uses: graphite in pencils, chlorine in water, iodised salt and nitrogen in food packets; the full set of uses still needs checking next time.
Pari showed understanding of oxygen, carbon and nitrogen as essential to living things, including nitrogen compounds in soil and fertilisers.
Pari first questioned the need for fertilisers and then corrected the idea by explaining that plants cannot directly use nitrogen gas.
end.parentNote: Pari practised linking non-metals to everyday examples and explaining their uses. They used examples such as chlorine making water safer, iodine in salt, and nitrogen helping keep packets of food fresh; the chlorine explanation was developed during the lesson. They also corrected the fertiliser mix-up by distinguishing nitrogen gas in air from usable nitrogen compounds in soil. At home, ask Pari to make a two-column table of each non-metal and one everyday use, then add the reason for that use.

Haan, oxygen saans aur jalne dono mein kaam aati hai, aur paudhe mitti ke nitrogen compounds se proteins banate hain. Ab school garden mein hawa hote hue bhi mitti mein nitrogen kam ho, toh paudhe hawa ki nitrogen gas seedhe kyun nahi le sakte?

didi hawa mein toh nitrogen gas hai na, lekin paudhe seedha nahi le sakte usse. unko chahiye hota hai... mitti mein jo compounds hote hain na, jaise aapne likha hai board pe, toh wohi nitrogen ka form unke liye usable hai. gas wali form se paudhe kuch nahi kar paate, kyunki unki roots mitti se absorb karti hain na, hawa se nahi!

Haan, sahi: paudhe nitrogen gas seedhe nahi le sakte; jadon se mitti ke nitrogen compounds lete hain. Ab isi baat ko aage badhayein: hawa mein itni nitrogen hote hue bhi kisaan nitrogen wala khaad kyun daalta hai?

kyunki kisaan ko lagta hai mitti mein nitrogen kam hai, par didi aapne abhi bataya ki hawa mein toh nitrogen gas hai hi, toh fir khaad dalne ki zaroorat kya? waise bhi mummy kehti hai overuse se mitti kharab ho jaati hai, isliye khaad nahi dalna chahiye na?

Aap keh rahi hain ki hawa mein nitrogen hai, toh khaad ki zaroorat nahi honi chahiye. Lekin paudhon ki jadon ke liye hawa ki nitrogen gas aur mitti ke nitrogen compounds alag hain: khaad mitti mein woh compounds badha sakta hai; zaroorat se zyada khaad nuksaan kar sakta hai, is baat par mummy sahi hain. Agar mitti mein paudhon ke liye nitrogen compounds kam hon, toh khaad ka kya fayda hoga?

didi, kyunki hawa ki nitrogen gas ko paudhe seedha use nahi kar sakte hain, unki jadon ko mitti se compounds chahiye hote hain jaise proteins banane ke liye, aur khaad wahi compounds mitti mein daalta hai, isliye zaroorat padti hai. lekin waise bhi meri mummy kehti hai overuse nahi karna chahiye, mitti kharab ho jaati hai!

Bilkul, aapne farq sahi pakda: jadon ko mitti ke nitrogen compounds chahiye, aur khaad unki kami poori kar sakta hai. Zyada khaad se nuksaan ho sakta hai, yeh baat bhi sahi hai. Ab rozmarra ki ek cheez sochiye: pencil ki lead asal mein kis non-metal se bani hoti hai?
